overrideBindings.description:
The bindings to apply to the {@link DataDiagnostic#metricExpression} for all the entities in-scope
for the diagnostic and overrides {@link DataDiagnostic#bindings} but does not override
{@link DataDiagnostic#entitySpecificBindings}.

entityOverrideBindings.description:
The bindings to apply to specific entities in-scope for a {@link DataDiagnostic#metricExpression}.
Takes precedence over all other bindings including {@link DataDiagnostic#bindings},
{@link DataDiagnostic#entitySpecificBindings}, and {@link DataDiagnosticOverrideSpec#overrideBindings}.

overrideFilterSpec.description:
Overrides the scope of the {@link DataDiagnostic} according to the logic specified in
{@link DataDiagnosticFilterSpec}.

overrideEvaluationPeriod.description: Overrides the period with which the {@link DataDiagnostic#metricExpression} is being evaluated on.

title:
Spec passed into {@link DataTag} APIs to override the settings
already in-place on a specific {@link DataDiagnostic} instance such as the bindings or scope
of the diagnostic.
name: DataDiagnosticOverrideSpec
